verdict.rationale: Brex publishes an official MCP server on its developer site that lets AI assistants manage expenses, look up users, check cards, review banking transactions and track bills through natural language. A probe confirmed the documentation page at developer.brex.com/docs/mcp, and auth relies on scoped dashboard-generated user tokens. Missing for 10: MCP-specific connection/setup and auth details beyond the general API token guide, a detailed tool inventory, and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect successfully.
